name: Back
summary: Adds /trigger back, which returns you to the location you last teleported from using the Homes or Spawn packs. Optionally (off by default) it also remembers your death location.

mechanics.title: What sets the Back location
mechanics.description: Using /trigger home or /trigger spawn stores your position, rotation and dimension before the teleport. /trigger back teleports you there, across dimensions if needed. Using Back also records the place you left, so repeating /trigger back toggles between two places.

mechanics.title: Death location
mechanics.description: A 'Save Death Location' option, Disabled by default, makes Back also remember where you died. Operators toggle it through /function back:config.

mechanics.title: Delay and cooldown
mechanics.description: Operator-set values: delay (ticks you must stand still, default 0) and cooldown (seconds between uses, default 0). Messages: 'Teleporting back...', 'You have nowhere to go back to.', 'Your Back cooldown will end in N seconds.'

commands_and_keybinds: /trigger back : teleport to your last teleport-origin (or death location, if enabled)
/function back:config : (operators) Save Death Location toggle, Delay (/scoreboard players set #delay back.config <ticks>), Cooldown (/scoreboard players set #cooldown back.config <seconds>)
getting_started: After using /trigger home or /trigger spawn, type /trigger back to return.
editor_notes: Advancement text also mentions TPA, but no TPA pack/mod ships here; Homes and Spawn call back:set_back directly. Defaults (death off, delay 0, cooldown 0) are not overridden anywhere in the repo.
